$comment: Gameplay stats: the single source of truth for player and mob numbers.
Edited by tools/designer and by hand; baked into Stats.java by
tools/statgen/stats2java.py. Never edit Stats.java — edit this file.
Defaults are deliberately tuned so one sword hit still kills a mob
(attack 25 >= walker hp 20), and a player survives several contacts
before losing a life (100 hp / 15 damage).
